page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s2 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. This server features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, meaning hyperthreading is not active. It is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

The instance does not include any bundled local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application deployment. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with the instance. Additionally, the hardware configuration lacks any GPU acceleration, making it unsuitable for parallel computing or graphics-intensive tasks.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance represents an entry-level compute-focused profile. The dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable processing capabilities, though the absolute resource limits of 2 vCPUs and 4.0 GB of RAM restrict its utility to lightweight workloads. It is appropriate for basic web serving, small utility applications, lightweight background workers, and development or testing environments that do not require high memory capacity or local storage performance.
